versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations And Information
versions.text: (a) The maximum altitude up to which operation is allowed, as limited by flight, structural, powerplant, functional, or equipment characteristics, must be established. (b) A maximum operating altitude limitation of not more than 7620 m (25 000 ft) must be established for pressurised aeroplanes, unless compliance with CS 23.775 (e) is shown.
